root_cause_label: Spec Violation via Missing Product Title Field and Modified Prompt Due to Absent LFS Data File
one_sentence_failure_summary: At step 43 the agent decided to proceed without the required product_title column (shopping_queries_dataset_products.parquet was never downloaded via git-lfs), writing a spec-violating esci.jsonl and planning a modified prompt, after which 250+ steps were consumed in a futile loop failing to register the task in lm-evaluation-harness due to incompatible torch/transformers versions.
t_err_evidence: I will have to proceed without the product titles... I will have to modify the prompt to not use the product title.
t_commit_evidence: Step 48 terminal output: 'Number of examples in esci.jsonl: 93347' - the spec-violating JSONL was successfully written without product_title, and at step 49 the agent moved on to clone lm-evaluation-harness, locking in the spec-violating dataset.
trigger_explanation: The agent assumed the products.parquet file simply did not exist in the repository and could not be obtained, without attempting git lfs pull or downloading the LFS pointer file. This false premise (the data is unavailable) led it to violate the spec by proceeding without product_title rather than fetching the actual file.
fabrication_evidence: Step 48: esci.jsonl written with only query/esci_label/product_locale/product_id columns (93347 examples), deliberately omitting the required product_title field. The agent explicitly stated it would 'proceed without the product titles' and 'modify the prompt to not use the product title', creating a dataset that does not conform to the task specification.
